name: KenyonExpress - Routes, money and queues
description: The six panels SECTIONS 41 names: error rate by route, p95 latency by route, payment success rate, webhook lag, queue depth and cache hit rate. Every query reads an event this codebase really emits; axiom-dashboard-contract.test.ts fails the build if that stops being true.

charts.name: Error rate by route (% of requests answering 5xx or throwing)

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event in ('request.completed', 'request.failed') | extend failed = iff(event == 'request.failed' or status >= 500, 1, 0) | summarize error_rate = 100.0 * sum(failed) / count() by bin_auto(_time), route
['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'request.completed' | summarize p95 = percentile(duration_ms, 95) by bin_auto(_time), route

charts.name: Slowest routes right now (p50 / p95 / p99, ms)

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'request.completed' | summarize requests = count(), p50 = percentile(duration_ms, 50), p95 = percentile(duration_ms, 95), p99 = percentile(duration_ms, 99) by route | sort by p95 desc | limit 25
['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'payment.event' and event_type in ('finalize_succeeded', 'finalize_failed') | summarize success_rate = 100.0 * countif(event_type == 'finalize_succeeded') / count()

charts.name: Money path transitions over time, by state

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'payment.event' | summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event_type

charts.name: Webhook lag: p95 handler time, and the dead letters behind it

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where (event == 'request.completed' and route == '/api/payments/cardcom/webhook') or (event == 'queue.depth' and queue == 'payment_webhook_dlq') | summarize p95_handler_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95), dead_letters = max(pending) by bin_auto(_time)

charts.name: Queue depth, every sweep (not only the bad ones)

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'queue.depth' | summarize pending = max(pending) by bin_auto(_time), queue

charts.name: Cache hit rate at the edge (from the 5-minute synthetic probe)

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'synthetic.probe' | summarize hit_rate = 100.0 * countif(cache_status == 'HIT') / count() by bin_auto(_time), target

charts.name: Synthetic probe: status and round trip per target

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'synthetic.probe' | summarize probes = count(), failures = countif(status != 200), p95_ms = percentile(duration_ms, 95), hits = countif(cache_status == 'HIT') by target | sort by failures desc
